comment: The person this practice is. Declared here rather than written into the pages because a name, a job title and an anchor recur across structured data, headings and meta descriptions, and one that a rebrand misses ships a site claiming a real person it has nothing to do with. The biography below is the other half and is deliberately not tokenised: a new owner writes their own rather than filling in these blanks. scripts/rehearse_rebrand.py counts every one of these strings that survives a rebrand and reports the number, the same treatment brand_name gets and for the same reason.
name: Jonathan Bowker
